n: SikaRoof VersiJack Exposed Paver Retainer Spacer Tab

d.t: SPACER TAB FOR EXPOSED PAVER RETAINER SYSTEM FOR RAISED PAVERS FLOORING
d.s: SikaRoof VersiJack Exposed Paver Retainer Spacer Tab is an attachment used on top of adjustable pedestals to secure pavers down and increase wind uplift resistance. Spacer tabs are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP) and is used in conjunction with SikaRoof VersiJack Exposed Paver Retainer to form a complete wind uplift system. SikaRoof VersiJack Exposed Paver Retainer Spacer Tab may be manufactured with tabs of various thicknesses to create varying drainage gaps sizes, to support concrete pavers, stone pavers, and porcelain tiles that have a minimum thickness of 20 mm.
a: Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Spacer tabs are used with adjustable pedestals for raised pavers flooring on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes to achieve wind uplift resistance.
